comment: Sketch1 on XY: two free points that frame the view's fit and a half disc of r 20 about the origin, for Sketch Fillet at its corner (20, 0) (mitcad#1192). As a Trim leaves a corner, the line c3 from (20, 0) (p4) to (-20, 0) (p5) and the arc c6 over (0, 20) end at (20, 0) in two points: the arc's own start (p7) is held on the line by a point-on-curve; at (-20, 0) they share p5.
